component.name: cloudillo native components
component.description: Hand-maintained: components compiled from source or copied as bare files into the FROM scratch image. Debian packages (debian:source set) are listed without version; release.sh fills in version, purl, .deb URL and SHA-256 from apt. Update when the Dockerfile adds or removes a component, or bumps a pinned source or base image.
